prompt:
A high-fidelity visual design mockup of a MOBILE WEB PAGE, portrait phone viewport, full-bleed screen design. Flat screen design only: no phone hardware frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no device photograph. It is a birthday party invitation page designed as a printed harbour almanac page.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom, as regions of a web page. No navigation bar.

REGION 1, the whole screen ground: warm letterpress almanac paper, aged cream, with visible paper tooth and the faint bite of metal type. Hairline brass-coloured rules divide the page horizontally into a strict tabular grid.

REGION 2, the head of the sheet, centred: a small finely engraved gilt-brass plate device, a birthday cake with exactly FIVE slim lit candles framed inside a circular life ring, drawn as a 19th-century almanac line engraving in fine brass-gold linework. Small, precise, plate-like. The five candle flames are the only warm orange in the image.

REGION 3, beneath it: HBD SUMMER PARTY set in dark navy ink, in a heavy letterpress roman capital, tight and orderly, sitting between two hairline rules like an almanac's day heading.

REGION 4, the centre of the page and its main event: a ruled almanac table with hairline rules, its rows in old-style tabular figures, dark navy ink on cream. Row labels on the left in small tracked capitals, figures right-aligned. The row reading HIGH WATER 17:00 is the single bold row, set noticeably heavier than every other row, in the same navy ink. Other rows show the date 2026.08.28 and short entries. Everything is exactly aligned to the tabular grid.

REGION 5, running down the outer margin beside the table: a vertical column of exactly FIVE identical small engraved marks, evenly spaced, all precisely the same size, none emphasised, where an almanac prints its moon-phase symbols.

REGION 6, the foot of the sheet: a line of Korean text 어반피크닉 워터파티룸 · 분당서현 in small navy letterpress type, and beneath it a narrow band of pale tide-teal.

PALETTE, strictly: aged almanac cream, dark navy printing ink, hairline brass gold, pale tide teal, one small flame orange only at the five candles. Quiet, exact, orderly, warm printed matter. Absolutely not a busy collage, no decoration outside the grid.

No people, no faces, no logos, no photographs, no prices, no invented claims, no text beyond what is specified.
